proposal_title: 100‑epoch Confirmation of Local Width 10 on ECG200
comment: Approved for scientific review. The preregistered w10 confirmation design is acceptable: ECG200, seeds 201–205, 100 epochs, concurrent w16 control, 500 test predictions per model, with the success gate w10_correct ≥ w16_correct − 10. Approval is for this exact experiment design only.
